grades.quote: When there are no more bytes to read, read returns zero to indicate the end of the file.
grades.reason: It says read returns zero at end of file and that close releases descriptors. That is background for the EOF symptom. It never says a pipe reader gets EOF only after every write end is closed, so it doesn't diagnose why EOF isn't reached after a child exits.

This is only a figure caption and pseudocode about overlapping locks that avoid lost wake-ups in piperead/sleep. It says nothing about EOF, closing write ends, or child exit, so it doesn't help diagnose the missing EOF.
